messages:
nina_sales: Heads-up — APAC reseller (PacificBridge, SG) is asking for a special channel margin + SOC2 evidence to close a regulated finance POC. Need deal-desk + legal + finance input. @tom_partnerships @julia_dealdesk


tom_partnerships: what's the ask exactly? how far off is it from our APAC rate card?


nina_sales: they want 28% channel discount for a 60d POC and 26% if they secure a $300k ARR commit within 9 months. Our APAC default is 22%. They're also requesting us to provide SOC2 Type II summary + a signed DPA and a one-time MDF of SGD15k.


julia_dealdesk: we need a quick margin + rev impact. Also confirm partner commission vs discount (partners often want margin, not additional commission). Can you drop the CRM opp id and expected ARR cadence?


nina_sales: CRM opp ID: RDW-APAC-4821. Customer potential $430k ARR. POC expected billable ~ $45k. Ramp assumptions in the opp notes.


omear_finance: flagging finance: big MDF and higher discount will compress gross margin. We need a simple delta calc and whether MDF is recoverable on a clause if commit not hit. Also need to tag budget to partner co-marketing line, not product.


kai_ps: PS note — POC will require ~60 hours of integration + 16 hours of runbook and support for demo. If MDF doesn't cover PS, request a PS voucher. Also any reduced SLA windows must be captured in the SOW.


tom_partnerships: I'm open to a time-limited concession if we get: 1) partner-signed commitment addendum with clear clawback for MDF, 2) the SOC2 summary and DPA in place before POC start, 3) deal-desk + finance signoff. Will escalate to legal for DPA template.


julia_dealdesk: Opening ticket DD-9901 to track approvals and attach docs. Please upload the SOC2 summary, DPA, CRM opp, and quick revenue calc there. https://redwood.company/dealdesk/DD-9901 :eyes:


nina_sales: uploading SOC2 summary + DPA draft now. Quick calc in-thread for reviewers:

```
POC list price (est): $45,000
Requested discount: 28% => customer pays $32,400
Partner margin (proposed): 18% on net => $5,832
One-time MDF: SGD15,000 (~$11k) credited to partner
Immediate net to Redwood on POC ~ $32,400 - $5,832 - $11,000 = ~$15,568
Baseline (22% discount): customer pays $35,100 -> net delta ~ +$2.7k vs concession
```


omear_finance: thanks — need this in RevOps model. Also confirm currency exposure (SGD vs USD) and tax/VAT handling.


legal-bot: DPA checklist: need data processing roles, transfer mechanisms, liability caps. Escalating to legal team for redline; expect 48h turnaround.


julia_dealdesk: conditions for approval doc'd in DD-9901: 1) signed partner addendum with commit & MDF clawback, 2) SOC2 summary + DPA uploaded, 3) PS voucher approval or MDF applied to PS, 4) finance tags and RevOps model updated. If all met, deal-desk can approve a temporary 28% POC discount and 26% post-commit for 12 months.


nina_sales: will confirm PS owners and ask partner to sign addendum before POC kickoff. Partner asked about whether reseller can invoice monthly vs upfront — finance, is monthly acceptable?


omear_finance: monthly invoicing ok but requires forecast adjustments and payment terms to be explicit. We'll accept but need AR contact and expected billing cadence in the CRM opp.


tom_partnerships: great. I will coordinate with partner on addendum and push legal on the DPA. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
